name: ledger
description: Working-memory discipline for any multi-phase task: keep a <task>-progress.md ledger as the source of truth (goal/DONE, phase status, decisions, do-NOT-re-raise list, anomalies, environment facts, unexercised cells), update it before every commit, /compact only at phase boundaries, and resume any session via read-ledger → next phase → gates → commit → update. Distilled from the engine's context-budgeting discipline so it composes with any execution mode.
